summary:
## Standing operator rules
Never use `print()` or the standard-library `logging` module in Ledgerly; add events through `structlog` in the owning service module.

Never create or modify a Stripe webhook without placing the ADR link in #billing-integrations and tagging @priya.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

Run “Python library release 2.8.0” between other work, in order, one at a time: verify `git status --porcelain && python -m pytest -q`; `hatch version 2.8.0`; generate release notes; commit; tag/push; build; Twine-check/upload; publish the specified `gh release create`.

## Current objective
Fix scheduler recurrence across DST while preserving local wall time. The prior dunning email fix is superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Active schema: `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is frozen and must never be seeded or written. Use `structlog`, `current_request_id`, and `2.8.0`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Webhook retry decorator with 5 attempts caused duplicate customer emails.

## Recent work
Patched recurrence calculation to combine dates with `schedule.tzinfo` and convert to UTC. Added/updated DST tests, including midnight transitions. Scheduler and billing tests pass: 31 passed.
